## Audit against plan steps 1-7

1. `jsonld.ts`: `collectionPage({url,name,description,itemListId})` present.
   `organization` carries `alternateName`, `areaServed: 'SA'`, `contactPoint`
   (gated on a phone existing). `localBusiness` carries an `address` fallback
   to `ox.seo.branch.street` when `branch_address` is empty, `geo` alongside
   it (only with a real address), `currenciesAccepted: 'SAR'`, `hasMap` from
   `google_place_url` (falling back to `branch_map_url`). `organization.sameAs`
   also includes `google_place_url`. Confirmed by
   `tests/pages/jsonld.test.ts` (`siteJsonLd` describe block, 9 cases) and the
   committed `tests/fixtures/jsonld/b5-site-branch.json`. No change needed.
2. `listing/head.ts`: title/description from `nodeBySlug(slug)` when the path
   names a taxonomy node, engine's own otherwise. Canonical: a lone `page` >1
   gets `?page=N` and stays indexable (`paginationCanonical`); any other query
   key cleans the canonical and forces `noindex, follow`; search and tags pass
   `{ noindex: true }` explicitly at the route. Graph: CollectionPage always
   (when a canonical exists), ItemList only with products, BreadcrumbList from
   `data.page.breadcrumbs`, FAQPage from `listingFaqItems`. Confirmed by
   `tests/listing/head.test.ts` (21 cases, including the committed
   `b4-category.json` fixture match) and the curls below. No change needed.
3. PDP head (`routeHeads.ts` `productHeadExtend`): adds a BreadcrumbList from
   `page.breadcrumbs` into the engine's own graph, substitutes the effective
   (non-zero) price into the Product offer, adds a Service node for
   `variantOf(type) === 'service'`. The five required Product properties
   (name, image, description, offers.price/priceCurrency/availability with
   `OutOfStock` for `is_out_of_stock`) and the `rating.count > 0` gate on
   `AggregateRating` are the engine's own builder
   (`node_modules/@salla.sa/twilight-theme-engine/dist/routes/product.js:174`:
   `if (product2.rating && product2.rating.count > 0)`), audited rather than
   reimplemented, and asserted by `tests/seo/pdpRequiredProperties.test.ts`
   over all 6 PDP fixture kinds (product, food, bundle, digital, giftcard,
   service). No change needed.
4. Home head (`homeHeadExtend`): title/description from `ox.seo.home.title` /
   `.description`, matching keywords-ar.md H01 verbatim in both locales
   (checked by hand and by the snippet-contract test). No change needed.
5. Brand/blog/page heads: `brandHeadExtend` rebuilds the title from
   `ox.seo.brand.title_pattern` (B01-B05 pattern). `articleHeadExtend` adds
   one `Article` node (`jsonld.ts:241`). Canonical (C12) and robots were
   correct on every route already wired
   (`index.tsx`, `$slug.p$id.tsx`, `$slug.c$id.tsx`, `brands.tsx`,
   `brands.$id.tsx`, `blog.tsx`, `blog_.$slug.a-$id.tsx`, `$slug.page-$id.tsx`,
   `tags.$id.tsx`, `$slug.tag-$id.tsx`, `search.tsx`, `cart.tsx`,
   `testimonials.tsx`, `loyalty.tsx`, `thankyou.$orderId.tsx`, the five
   `pageHead` routes). Three routes were missing entirely: **fixed**, see
   below.
6. Alt-text / answer-first audit: `product/OxProductCard.tsx`,
   `product/BuyZone/PdpGallery.tsx`, `listing/BrandHeader.tsx`,
   `listing/BrandsGrid.tsx`, `home/OxBrands.tsx` all pass a real name

7. Fixtures: 13 files under `tests/fixtures/jsonld/`, all `pnpm check:jsonld`

## Fixed: three S3-owned routes had no head extension at all

`app/routes/blog_.$slug.tag-$id.tsx`, `blog_.author.$id.tsx` and
`blog_.$slug.c-$id.tsx` were still the engine's stock `// @auto-generated`
scaffold: `head: withHead(BlogTagRoute)` / `withHead(BlogAuthorRoute)` /
`withHead(BlogCategoryRoute)` with no second argument, so none of the three
got the C12 canonical correction and the tag/author archives were indexable
(the plan step 5 explicitly calls for "robots for blog tag/author (noindex,
follow)"; brand/blog/page heads collectively get the canonical fix per the
same step). Fixed, `head` export only in each file:

- `blog_.$slug.tag-$id.tsx`: `head: withHead(BlogTagRoute, commerceHeadExtend({ noindex: true }))`.
- `blog_.author.$id.tsx`: `head: withHead(BlogAuthorRoute, commerceHeadExtend({ noindex: true }))`.
- `blog_.$slug.c-$id.tsx`: `head: withHead(BlogCategoryRoute, commerceHeadExtend())`
  (indexable: a blog category groups guides the same way a store category
  groups products, unlike the tag/author archives).

## Fixed: the snippet-contract test was carrying stale allowlist entries and missing two real breaches

`pnpm vitest run tests/seo` was 45/47 (2 failed) at handoff. Both failures
were the allowlist being out of date with the shipped copy, not a defect in
the contract logic:

- Two allowlist entries no longer breach (content already fixed upstream by
  the voice sweep since the allowlist was written): `en:tax.snacks_bars.description`
  (144/160) and `en:tax.goal_hair_skin.description` (133/160). Removed.
- Three real English breaches were not yet allowlisted, all in content S3
  does not own (`locales/` values, never edited per the locales protocol):
  - `services: description 176/160`, `ox.services.meta_description`,
    `locales/partials/b5.en.json`. **Request to S6** (owns `b5.*`): the
    English description needs shortening to at most 160 characters (target
    140-160), same trim `about.description` already carries an allowlist
    entry for.
  - `tax.accessories: description 164/160` and `tax.services: description
    164/160`, `ox.tax.accessories.description` / `ox.tax.services.description`,
    `locales/partials/tax.en.json`. **Request to S4** (owns `tax.*` EN
    values per the existing allowlist convention): both need trimming to at
    most 160 characters.

`tests/seo/snippetContract.test.ts` `ALLOWLIST`: removed the two stale
entries, added `en:services.description`, `en:tax.accessories.description`,
`en:tax.services.description`, each with the same "content owned elsewhere,
request filed here" reason the existing entries use. No locale value was
touched (constraint honoured).

## `/categories`: `categoriesHeadExtend` wiring

`categoriesHeadExtend` (in `routeHeads.ts` from the prior pass) is correct
and tested (`tests/seo/routeHeads.test.ts`: builds a `CollectionPage` node
from `pageHead`'s own title/description/canonical, ar and en). It is **not
yet wired into the live route**: `app/routes/categories.tsx` still calls
`pageHead(...)` directly, so `/categories` ships no JSON-LD today.

**Request to S1** (owns `app/routes/categories.tsx`, not edited here): swap
the `head` builder for the drop-in replacement (same `PageHeadOptions` shape,
same return type):

```diff
-import { pageHead } from '../components/pages/head';
+import { categoriesHeadExtend } from '../components/seo/routeHeads';
 ...
   head: withHead({
-    head: pageHead({
+    head: categoriesHeadExtend({
       path: '/categories',
       titleKey: CATEGORIES_INDEX_KEYS.title,
       descriptionKey: CATEGORIES_INDEX_KEYS.description,
     }),
   }),
```

## Deviations

- Three route files (`blog_.$slug.tag-$id.tsx`, `blog_.author.$id.tsx`,
  `blog_.$slug.c-$id.tsx`) had their `// @auto-generated` header comment
  removed as part of the `head` export edit, matching every other S3-owned
  route that has already moved off the engine's stock scaffold
  (`$slug.p$id.tsx`, `$slug.c$id.tsx`, `brands.tsx`, `brands.$id.tsx`): once
  a route carries a hand-written `head` extension it is no longer the
  generator's untouched output, and the brief's "leave alone" list names
  only `account.pending_orders.tsx` and `logout.tsx`.
- No fixture was added for a brand-listing or blog-category JSON-LD shape:
  neither carries a node kind not already covered by an existing fixture
  (brand listing reuses the b4-category shape; blog category is `commerceHeadExtend()`
  with no JSON-LD, same as `blog.tsx`), so accept criterion 7 ("one JSON per
  route kind") is read as one JSON per distinct graph shape, which is met.
